opening_analysis.diagnosis: The opening immediately clarifies what Lean 4 proves and does not prove, establishing trust and preventing overclaim. However, it lacks a narrative hook or a compelling question to draw in a broader audience. The thesis ('the architecture is internally consistent') is clear but could be more provocative.

unresolved_tensions: The document claims the architecture is domain-neutral (Master Equation) but also asserts structural priority of good over evil (PolarityDiscipline). This tension is not explicitly resolved.

missing_bridges: Transition from Layer 8 (Maxwell/Trinity) to Layer 9 (Cross Uniqueness) could be smoother; the jump from physics/theology isomorphism to moral repair feels abrupt.
redundant_passages: The 'overclaim guard' explanation appears in both the opening context and the Layer 8 section.
flow.suggested_reorder: Consider moving the 'Named Gaps' section immediately after the Layer 16 summary to reinforce honesty before the architecture diagram.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: Lean 4 proves structural consistency, not real-world truth.
The corpus makes structural claims machine-checkable and adversarially testable.
Maxwell/Trinity isomorphism is the strongest standalone result.
Five false positives were tested and rejected.
Quaternion EM passes all five ValidTriadic conditions.
Trinity relational model passes all five ValidTriadic conditions.
Full structural isomorphism is proved.
Coupling invariant is present in quaternion EM but absent in vector-only EM.
Heaviside vector-only EM rejected.
Modalism rejected.
Static single-field EM rejected.
Generic 3-part system rejected.
Safe public wording clarifies what Lean does and does not prove.
The Cross is the unique solution to the Justice/Mercy operator.
Theorem 125 proves uniqueness by exhaustive case elimination.
Cross satisfies all five convergence conditions.
Offender payment fails mercy condition.
Human third party fails authority and capacity.
Waived debt fails justice condition.
Uniqueness is within the model; historical evidence is separate.

rearrangement_suggestions: Move 'Named Gaps' section to immediately after Layer 16 summary to reinforce honesty before architecture diagram.
Consider moving the 'Borrowed Foundation' section (Core.lean + BridgeMatrix) before the flagship results to establish the substrate claim first.
Split the 'What Lean 4 Actually Proves' opening into two paragraphs: one for what Lean does, one for what it does not do.
top_3_fixes: Add a transition sentence between Layer 8 (Maxwell/Trinity) and Layer 9 (Cross Uniqueness) to connect the physics/theology isomorphism to the moral repair framework.
Remove the redundant 'overclaim guard' explanation in Layer 8 section since it already appears in the opening context.
Strengthen the title to be more specific and curiosity-pulling, e.g., 'The Bilateral Audit: A Lean 4 Formal Verification of Theophysics Structural Claims'.
